ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising_edge clock used by all clocked processes; sequences registers such as ctrl, engine, clk_gen, io_con and irq generation logic.
ports.evidence: Used in rising_edge(clk_i) in multiple processes: bus_access, irq_generator, clock_generator, phase_generator, twi_engine.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides an asynchronous active-low reset that clears control, engine and clock-generator registers and initializes outputs in each process' reset branch.
ports.evidence: Tested as if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in reset branches of all clocked processes.

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Receives the incoming bus transaction bundle and supplies fields (stb,rw,addr,data,...) used to update control registers, drive FIFOs and produce bus responses.
ports.evidence: Port record declared in the port-clause and its fields are referenced in bus_access and concurrent assignments.

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Supplies address bits (bit 2 tested) used to select CSR vs FIFO accesses and to qualify write/read actions; it gates control and FIFO-write/read assignments.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.addr(2) compared in bus_access and used in concurrent conditional assignments (e.g. fifo.tx_we, fifo.rx_re).

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries write-data from the bus that is sampled to update ctrl fields and drives TX FIFO write data; consumed by bus_access and TX FIFO write path.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.data bits are read to assign ctrl fields and fifo.tx_wdata in bus_access and concurrent assignments.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request record but not referenced anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences besides the port declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Used both as a gating condition for bus accesses and directly fed back as the response ack; it gates CSR/FIFO reads and writes and drives bus_rsp_o.ack.
ports.evidence: Tested in if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and used in conditional concurrent assignments (e.g. fifo.tx_we) and assigned to bus_rsp_o.ack.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Determines read vs write branch in bus_access and participates in the enable terms for FIFO write/read; it gates control register writes and data reads.
ports.evidence: Used in if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... in bus_access and in fifo.tx_we / fifo.rx_re enable conditions.

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not used anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: No references besides the port declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not read or used in this entity's source.
ports.evidence: No occurrences besides the port declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Part of the bus request record but not referenced in this design unit.
ports.evidence: Only declared in the port clause; not used.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No usage besides declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Present in the record but not used in this entity's logic.
ports.evidence: No occurrences in the source apart from the port clause.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared in the record but not read anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: Only in port declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this entity.
ports.evidence: No references other than declaration.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Provides the bus response bundle (ack, err, data) back to the bus master; its fields are driven in the clocked bus_access process from bus_req and internal status.
role: register group updated on bus cycles
ports.evidence: Fields assigned in bus_access process (bus_rsp_o.ack, .err, .data).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Captured each bus cycle from bus_req_i.stb inside bus_access and returned to the bus master as the ack field.
ports.evidence: Assigned in bus_access: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb (inside rising_edge(clk_i)).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Held as '0' by the bus_access process (error is not reported here); driven to a constant in the clocked response path.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in the rising_edge(clk_i) branch of bus_access (assigned constant).

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Provides readback data to the bus: on CSR reads it reports ctrl and status bits; on FIFO read it returns fifo.rx_rdata; constructed from ctrl fields, io_con samples, FIFO status and rx data.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data bits are assigned in bus_access from ctrl fields, io_con.s*_in_ff, fifo.rx_avail, fifo.tx_free and fifo.rx_rdata(8 downto 0).

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Forwards the internal ctrl.enable bit to the outside as the clock-generator enable signal.
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignment: clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable.

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Provides selectable phase-enable bits; a single bit, indexed by ctrl.prsc, is tested in the clock_generator to gate cnt increments and ticking.
ports.evidence: Tested as clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) = '1' in clock_generator process to gate counting/tick logic.

ports.name: twi_sda_i
ports.functionality: Converted and presented as io_con.sda_in, which is then sampled into io_con.sda_in_ff for engine use.
ports.evidence: Assigned: io_con.sda_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_sda_i)).

ports.name: twi_sda_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SDA pin from the internal io_con.sda_out signal (direct combinational forwarding).
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignment: twi_sda_o <= io_con.sda_out.

ports.name: twi_scl_i
ports.functionality: Converted and provided as io_con.scl_in, then sampled into io_con.scl_in_ff for stretch detection and engine use.
ports.evidence: Assigned: io_con.scl_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_scl_i)).

ports.name: twi_scl_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SCL pin from the internal io_con.scl_out signal (forwarded combinationally).
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignment: twi_scl_o <= io_con.scl_out.

ports.name: irq_o
ports.functionality: Registered interrupt output asserted when ctrl.enable is set, TX FIFO not available and engine not busy; computed each clock and exposed externally.
ports.evidence: Assigned in irq_generator process at rising_edge(clk_i): irq_o <= ctrl.enable and (not fifo.tx_avail) and (not engine.busy).

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds TWI configuration fields (enable, prsc, cdiv, clkstr) written by bus writes and read back on CSR reads; supplies clocking and engine configuration.
signals.evidence: ctrl is a record signal whose fields are assigned in bus_access process from bus_req_i.data.

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Captured from bus_req_i.data on writes and read back; it enables the clock generator, gates FIFO clear, and is sampled into engine.state(2) to enable the engine.
signals.evidence: Assigned in bus_access: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); used in fifo.clear, clkgen_en_o, engine.state(2) and clock/phase generator conditions.

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used as an index into clkgen_i to select which bit gates the clock-counter; configures clock generation rate selection.
signals.evidence: Assigned in bus_access from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c); used as index in clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))).

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.functionality: Loaded from bus writes and compared against clk_gen.cnt to produce clk_gen.tick when equal; configures tick frequency.
role: compared to clk counter to generate tick
signals.evidence: Assigned in bus_access from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c); compared in clock_generator: if (clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv) then ...

signals.name: ctrl.clkstr
signals.functionality: Set by bus writes and used to qualify clk_gen.halt (clock stretching detection) and reported in CSR reads; gates halting of phase generator when stretch detected.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clkstr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_clkstr_en_c) in bus_access; used in clk_gen.halt concurrent assignment.

signals.name: fifo
signals.functionality: Groups control and data signals that interface to the TX/RX FIFO instances and to the engine; fields carry write/read enables, data and status between engine, bus and FIFO instances.
role: connects FIFOs to engine and bus logic
signals.evidence: fifo record declared and individual fields connected to instantiated FIFO ports and to engine/bus logic in port maps and concurrent assignments.

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Driven as the inverted ctrl.enable and routed to the FIFO instances' clear inputs to assert FIFO clear when controller disabled.
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable; connected to clear_i in both tx_fifo_inst and rx_fifo_inst port maps.

signals.name: fifo.rx_we
signals.functionality: Asserted by the engine's done signal to push received bytes into the RX FIFO; mapped to the RX FIFO instance we_i.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_we <= engine.done; rx_fifo_inst port map connects we_i => fifo.rx_we.

signals.name: fifo.tx_we
signals.functionality: Asserted when a bus write to the TX FIFO address occurs (bus_req_i.stb & rw & addr(2)=1); drives the TX FIFO we_i input.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; mapped to tx_fifo_inst.we_i.

signals.name: fifo.rx_re
signals.functionality: Asserted when the bus performs a read to the FIFO address (bus_req_i.stb & rw='0' & addr(2)=1); presented to RX FIFO re_i.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; mapped to rx_fifo_inst.re_i.

signals.name: fifo.tx_re
signals.functionality: Issued to read the next TX command when engine is idle, TX FIFO has data and clk tick occurs; mapped to TX FIFO re_i to consume commands into engine.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_re <= '1' when (engine.busy = '0') and (fifo.tx_avail = '1') and (clk_gen.tick = '1') else '0'; mapped to tx_fifo_inst.re_i.

signals.name: fifo.rx_wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the assembled received byte from engine.sreg into the RX FIFO wdata input as a 9-bit vector.
signals.evidence: fifo.rx_wdata <= engine.sreg(0) & engine.sreg(8 downto 1); mapped to rx_fifo_inst.wdata_i.

signals.name: fifo.rx_rdata
signals.functionality: Receives rdata from the RX FIFO instance and is returned to the bus on reads (mapped to bus_rsp_o.data(8 downto 0)).
signals.evidence: rx_fifo_inst rdata_o => fifo.rx_rdata in port map; used in bus_access: bus_rsp_o.data(8 downto 0) <= fifo.rx_rdata.

signals.name: fifo.tx_wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the command word written by the bus (dcmd_cmd_hi_c downto dcmd_lsb_c) into the TX FIFO wdata input.
signals.evidence: fifo.tx_wdata <= bus_req_i.data(dcmd_cmd_hi_c downto dcmd_lsb_c); mapped to tx_fifo_inst.wdata_i.

signals.name: fifo.tx_rdata
signals.functionality: Holds the command word read from the TX FIFO instance; consumed by the engine to load sreg and decide the command bits.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo_inst rdata_o => fifo.tx_rdata; used in twi_engine to load engine.sreg and engine.state bits.

signals.name: fifo.rx_avail
signals.functionality: Provided by the RX FIFO instance indicating data available; used in bus read status and returned in CSR reads.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo_inst avail_o => fifo.rx_avail in port map; used in bus_access to set bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_rx_avail_c).

signals.name: fifo.tx_avail
signals.functionality: Indicates TX FIFO has data (avail) from the TX FIFO instance; used to start engine transactions and reported in CSR busy calculation.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo_inst avail_o => fifo.tx_avail; used in fifo.tx_re condition and in bus_access to compute ctrl_busy_c.

signals.name: fifo.rx_free
signals.functionality: Provided by the RX FIFO instance but not used by this entity's logic except present in the FIFO bundle and connected to instance free_o.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo_inst free_o => fifo.rx_free in port map; not referenced elsewhere.

signals.name: fifo.tx_free
signals.functionality: Indicates TX FIFO free (not full) as provided by the TX FIFO instance; used in CSR read as ctrl_tx_full (inverted) and in bus_rsp_o.data mapping.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo_inst free_o => fifo.tx_free in port map; bus_access reads fifo.tx_free to drive bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_full_c) as not fifo.tx_free.

signals.name: clk_gen
signals.functionality: Holds internal clock-generation state (cnt,tick,phase_gen,phase_gen_ff,phase,halt) used to produce phased SCL/SDA control and ticks consumed by the engine and FIFO read pacing.
role: holds counter and phase shift registers
signals.evidence: clk_gen is a record with fields updated across clock_generator, phase_generator and concurrent assignments (phase, halt).

signals.name: clk_gen.cnt
signals.functionality: Counts up while ctrl.enable and the selected clkgen_i bit is '1'; compared to ctrl.cdiv to produce a tick and reset the counter on equality.
signals.evidence: Updated in clock_generator: increments or reset when (clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv) and gated by clkgen_i(index) and ctrl.enable.

signals.name: clk_gen.tick
signals.functionality: One-cycle pulse generated when clk_gen.cnt equals ctrl.cdiv while the selected clkgen_i bit is set; used to pace engine start and FIFO reads.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.tick set to '1' when clk_gen.cnt = ctrl.cdiv and clkgen_i(index) = '1' (clock_generator); used in fifo.tx_re condition and engine start logic.

signals.name: clk_gen.halt
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted when scl_out='1' and sampled scl_in_ff(1)='0' and ctrl.clkstr='1', preventing phase advancement (clock stretching).
signals.evidence: clk_gen.halt <= '1' when (io_con.scl_out = '1') and (io_con.scl_in_ff(1) = '0') and (ctrl.clkstr = '1') else '0'.

signals.name: clk_gen.phase_gen
signals.functionality: Holds the rotating one-hot phase pattern used to generate phases; shifted on each tick when not halted and loaded to default when disabled.
signals.evidence: Assigned in phase_generator process: shifts when clk_gen.tick='1' and clk_gen.halt='0', reset or initialized when disabled or engine.busy='0'.

signals.name: clk_gen.phase_gen_ff
signals.functionality: A one-cycle delayed copy of phase_gen used to derive phase edges; updated each clock from phase_gen.
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase_gen_ff <= clk_gen.phase_gen executed in phase_generator process; clk_gen.phase uses phase_gen_ff combinationally.

signals.name: clk_gen.phase
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived pulses from phase_gen_ff and phase_gen to indicate phase edges (phase(n) = phase_gen_ff(n) and not phase_gen(n)).
signals.evidence: clk_gen.phase(i) <= clk_gen.phase_gen_ff(i) and (not clk_gen.phase_gen(i)) for i=0..3.

signals.name: engine
signals.functionality: Holds engine state, bit counter, shift register and completion flag; coordinates bit-level SCL/SDA activity according to phases and TX FIFO commands.
role: drives io_con outputs and RX assembly
signals.evidence: engine record fields are assigned inside twi_engine process and used across the design (state machine, shifting and FIFO interfacing).

signals.name: engine.state
signals.functionality: Registers the 3-bit engine state; bit2 is fed by ctrl.enable and the 2 LSBs select the engine case that drives sda/scl outputs and sreg/bitcnt behavior.
signals.evidence: engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable; case engine.state is used in twi_engine to assign bitcnt, sreg, io_con outputs and done.

signals.name: engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts bits transmitted/received; incremented on phase(3) and compared to a terminal value to generate engine.done and control SDA behaviour.
signals.evidence: engine.bitcnt incremented when clk_gen.phase(3) = '1' and tested for equality to "1001" to set engine.done and affect SDA output.

signals.name: engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Loaded from fifo.tx_rdata at transaction start and shifted/updated from SDA input during transfers; supplies RX FIFO write data and drives SDA output bits.
signals.evidence: engine.sreg <= fifo.tx_rdata(...) & (not fifo.tx_rdata(dcmd_ack_c)) and later shifted with io_con.sda_in_ff(1) inside twi_engine; fifo.rx_wdata built from engine.sreg.

signals.name: engine.done
signals.functionality: Set when a byte-transfer completes (checked with bitcnt and phase), and cleared each clock; used to write received data into RX FIFO.
signals.evidence: engine.done <= '1' set inside twi_engine when conditions met; fifo.rx_we <= engine.done.

signals.name: engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived from engine.state to indicate that a transfer is in progress (state(2)=1 and state(1..0) != "00").
signals.evidence: engine.busy <= '1' when (engine.state(2) = '1') and (engine.state(1 downto 0) /= "00") else '0'.

signals.name: io_con
signals.functionality: Groups sampled inputs, direct inputs and outputs for SDA/SCL (sda_in_ff,scl_in_ff,sda_in,scl_in,sda_out,scl_out); mediates pin conversions and provides drive/monitor signals to the engine and CSR.
role: connects pins to engine and status logic
signals.evidence: io_con record declared and its fields are assigned in twi_engine, by pin conversions and used elsewhere (phase halt, CSR).

signals.name: io_con.sda_in_ff
signals.functionality: A two-bit shift that samples io_con.sda_in each clock (shift register); the MSB is used by the engine as the stable sampled SDA input and reported in CSR.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_in_ff <= io_con.sda_in_ff(0) & io_con.sda_in in twi_engine; io_con.sda_in_ff(1) read into bus_rsp_o.data and engine.sreg; used in clk_gen.halt condition.

signals.name: io_con.scl_in_ff
signals.functionality: Two-stage sampled version of SCL input; MSB is used for stretch detection and reported in CSR.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_in_ff <= io_con.scl_in_ff(0) & io_con.scl_in in twi_engine; io_con.scl_in_ff(1) used in bus_rsp_o.data and clk_gen.halt.

signals.name: io_con.sda_in
signals.functionality: Combinationally converted from the external twi_sda_i pin and provided to the input sampler chain.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_sda_i)).

signals.name: io_con.scl_in
signals.functionality: Combinationally converted from the external twi_scl_i pin and presented to the SCL sampler chain.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_in <= to_stdulogic(to_bit(twi_scl_i)).

signals.name: io_con.sda_out
signals.functionality: Registered drive level for SDA controlled by the engine state and phase logic; forwarded to the external twi_sda_o pin.
signals.evidence: io_con.sda_out assigned in twi_engine case branches; twi_sda_o <= io_con.sda_out.

signals.name: io_con.scl_out
signals.functionality: Registered drive level for SCL controlled by the engine and phase signals; forwarded to external twi_scl_o and used in halt detection.
signals.evidence: io_con.scl_out assigned in twi_engine branches; twi_scl_o <= io_con.scl_out and clk_gen.halt uses io_con.scl_out.
